owner: Government of Liberia / Ministry of Finance / Central Bank of Liberia / Libtelco
notes: ECOWAS Digital Observatory lists three government data centers in Liberia: Ministry of Finance, Monrovia; Central Bank, Monrovia; and Libtelco, Monrovia. The same page's annual data reports three government-owned data centers for 2023 and one for 2024; facility-level capacity not disclosed.
